user_model_brief: Single-user FastAPI+Postgres personal-intelligence-feed. Pluggable providers resolved from YAML via importlib. Owner values deep modules, high locality, precise vocabulary (strict CONTEXT.md glossary + 51 ADRs), 'do it now / avoid future migrations'. Separate workbench-meta repo imports a public surface. Owner chose AGGRESSIVE reorg + MOVE-AND-UPDATE-EVERYTHING (no shims, hard cutover) twice, with full knowledge of cross-repo + local-config costs.

settled_decisions.D1_scope: Aggressive: layered packages, rename modules, split models.py, regroup api.
settled_decisions.D2_import_paths: Move and update everything; no back-compat shims; hard cutover; update config.example.yml, local config.yml, string-literal allowlists, workbench-meta (lockstep PR), entrypoint/scripts.
settled_decisions.D4_enforcement: CLAUDE.md rule + pytest asserting every package dir under src/workbench has a non-empty README.md.
settled_decisions.D6_glossary_pin: Provider interface subfolder names (llm, source, messenger, queue_scorer, enrichment, connection, change_detector, doc_reader) are retained — renaming would contradict the 'Provider' glossary term.
settled_decisions.D8_main_move: main.py -> runtime/app.py; workbench.main:app -> workbench.runtime.app:app; update entrypoint + scripts (no main.py shim).

branches.topic: providers cleanup + README convention + test guard

decisions.question: Top-level taxonomy
decisions.answer: domain/ config/ runtime/ telemetry/ providers/ pipeline/ storage/ api/ mcp/ migrations/

decisions.question: models.py fate
decisions.answer: Split into domain/ package; rename workbench.models -> workbench.domain; __init__ re-exports full surface with __all__

decisions.question: domain submodules
decisions.answer: enums, items, pipeline, triage, diff, filters, preferences, enrichment, sources, plans

decisions.question: telemetry contents
decisions.answer: metrics, instrumentation, logging, usage_aggregator, alerting, privacy

decisions.question: web wiring
decisions.answer: runtime/ package: app.py (factory), auth.py, middleware.py; main:app moves to runtime.app:app

decisions.question: config placement
decisions.answer: config/ package: models.py + loader.py + writer.py; __init__ preserves workbench.config.load_config

decisions.question: README convention
decisions.answer: Every __init__.py-bearing dir under src/workbench except __pycache__ and migrations/versions gets a non-empty README.md

decisions.question: test guard
decisions.answer: tests/test_folder_docs.py walks src/workbench, parametrized per package dir, asserts README.md exists and is non-empty; exclusions __pycache__, migrations/versions

decisions.question: cutover atomicity
decisions.answer: single atomic commit in workbench using git mv; workbench-meta follows (dependency direction one-way)

decisions.question: reference classes to update
decisions.answer: static imports (ruff), YAML class: paths (grep *.yml), string-literal class paths in api/messenger.py+api/sources.py+config.py (grep .py), entrypoint/scripts main:app

decisions.question: CONTEXT.md duplication
decisions.answer: Make root CONTEXT.md authoritative; repoint tests/test_context_doc.py to it; delete/merge docs/CONTEXT.md

passes.judge_rationale: Two material gaps found and fixed: missing runtime/__init__.py creation step (D8 cutover-breaker); verification grep missed the 'from workbench import X' bare-import form.
Zero material edits. Verified 12 cross-repo domain symbols present, all moved modules have plan slices, __init__.py assumptions explicit, no circular imports, test guard exclusions sound.
